modern: Do the external things that befall you distract you? Give yourself time to learn something new and good, and stop being whirled around. But then you must also avoid being carried about the other way; for those too are triflers who have worn themselves out in life by their activity, and yet have no aim to which to direct every movement and, in a word, all their thoughts.
original: Do the things external which fall upon thee distract thee? Give thyself time to learn something new and good, and cease to be whirled around. But then thou must also avoid being carried about the other way; for those too are triflers who have wearied themselves in life by their activity, and yet have no object to which to direct every movement, and, in a word, all their thoughts.
